crossRefs.note: to deliver you from the strange woman, even from the foreigner who flatters with her words,
to keep you from the immoral woman, from the flattery of the wayward wife’s tongue.
With persuasive words, she led him astray. With the flattering of her lips, she seduced him.

translations.web: For the lips of an adulteress drip honey. Her mouth is smoother than oil,
translations.bsb: Though the lips of the forbidden woman drip honey and her speech is smoother than oil,
translations.kjv: For the lips of a strange woman drop as an honeycomb, and her mouth is smoother than oil:
